note: Independent re-judgment at HEAD against RFC 9687 Section 4.3 ('Each time the local system sends a BGP message, it restarts the SendHoldTimer'). Verified session_write.go::flushWrites calls resetSendHoldTimer only when s.writePending is set after successful flush, updating sendHoldDeadline atomically. Positives verify exact deadline restart and survival past 1.2x SendHoldTime across all BGP message types and writer rails: UPDATE, auto-flush, dirty-flush (verifying buffering alone does not move deadline and a later empty flush cannot reuse prior emission), KEEPALIVE, RouteRefresh/BoRR/EoRR, SendUpdate, sendWithdraw, sendRawUpdateBody, SendAnnounce, sendUpdateHeld, fwdBatchHandler raw/parsed, and SendRawMessage (TestRFC9687EmissionRestartsExactSendHoldDeadline, TestRFC9687EveryWriterRestartsTheSendHoldTimer, TestRFC9687RemainingWritersRestartSendHold, TestRFC9687SendRestartsTheSendHoldTimer). Negatives verify 13 policy-suppressed/duplicate/stale/empty/paths-limit no-emission paths leave deadline unchanged and expire at exact SendHoldTime (TestRFC9687SuppressedAttemptsDoNotRestartSendHold), and silence expires at 1.2x SendHoldTime (TestRFC9687SilenceDoesNotRestartTheSendHoldTimer). Q1-Q4 pass.
